About Us

Built independent.
Made to be heard worldwide.

Capacity Studio is an independent music production company and record label built on one belief: great sound has no borders. From the first sketch of a beat to the final master, everything is created in-house — with full creative control and a sound shaped for a global audience.

The studio blends hip-hop, rap, trap, UK drill, phonk, pop and experimental production into a catalogue that is raw, cinematic and unmistakably its own. Every release carries the same signature: heavy low end, sharp detail, and melodies that stay with you.

Capacity Studio is not chasing trends. It is building a catalogue — one release at a time.

Our Mission

To produce and release music with complete creative freedom, at a quality that stands next to any major-label record.

Our Vision

An independent sound with a global reach — music made without limits, heard everywhere.

Independence

Full ownership of the music, the masters and the direction.

Quality First

Every track is finished to release standard — no shortcuts.

Originality

A sound of our own, never a copy of someone else's.

Global Reach

Made independently, released for listeners worldwide.

Services

What the studio does

End-to-end production — from the first idea to a finished, release-ready record.

01

Music Production

Original beats and full track production across hip-hop, trap, UK drill, phonk, pop and experimental styles — built around the artist, never off the shelf.

02

Mixing & Mastering

Clean, powerful mixes and masters finished for streaming, radio and video — loud where it matters, detailed everywhere.

03

Vocal Production

Recording direction, tuning, layering and effects that put the voice exactly where it belongs — front and centre.

04

Beat Licensing

Catalogue beats available for licensing for independent artists and creators, with clear terms agreed before release.

05

Creative & Visual Production

Cover art, visuals and release presentation designed to match the sound — one identity across every platform.

Record Label

Discover. Develop. Release.

The label side of Capacity Studio finds raw talent, shapes it in the studio, and puts it in front of the world — independently.

Discover

We look for original voices and sounds with something real to say — character first, always.

Develop

Artists are developed in the studio: production, vocal work and a sound built around who they are.

Release

Finished records are released worldwide on all major platforms under the Capacity Studio label.

Artists / Founder

Mahdi Hasan Joy

Founder & CEO — Producer

Mahdi Hasan Joy is the founder, CEO and producer behind Capacity Studio. Every release in the catalogue is produced by Mahdi Hasan — from the first drum pattern to the final master.

Working across hip-hop, rap, trap, UK drill, phonk and experimental production, he built Capacity Studio as a fully independent home for his sound: no gatekeepers, no compromises, and a single standard — if it carries the Capacity Studio name, it has to be world-class.
